objects.name: Analytic 2172
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Internet Control Message Protocol (ICMP) echo sweeps, Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) broadcast floods, or Industrial Control System (ICS)-specific discovery protocol packets from a host generating traffic to all IPs in a subnet in sequential order, a sweep pattern distinct from normal operational traffic to known device Internet Protocol (IP) addresses only. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
